entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'agent' to speak with a representative.
Agent.
Connecting you now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I need to... I think I need to make a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Mark Calloway, order number VF78501.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 27th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, no, it works perfectly fine. I just... I guess I've **changed my mind**. It was a bit of an **impulse buy** after Christmas, and I really **don't use it** as much as I thought I would.
I see. So it's not a defect, you've just decided it's not the right fit for your routine. I understand.
Yes, exactly. I tried to look on the website for the policy but it was all so confusing with different dates for different things. I'm just not sure what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help clarify that for you. Let me just pull up the official policy details for your item... Okay, I see your order was delivered 18 days ago.
Is... is that bad?
Not at all. According to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, as long as they are in the original condition. You are well within that 90-day window.
Oh! Really? So I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack it back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's wonderful! Thank you so much, that's such a relief. I was really worried I was stuck with it.

You're very welcome, Mark. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. The email with the label should be in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Diana!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
